audit.kind: TRUST_UPGRADE cross-verification of committed owner-provided text against MOJ legal-portal database (get-Section-Changes per leaf)
audit.similarity_metric: token-set Jaccard after normalization (NFKC, strip diacritics+tatweel, أإآ→ا, ى→ي, ة→ه, Arabic-Indic→ASCII digits, keep Arabic+digit runs only); seq_similarity = difflib ratio on the normalized token stream
audit.madda_sequence_note: MOJ DB contains exactly 721 المادة leaves whose Arabic-ordinal labels convert to 1..721 in strict document order — complete, no gaps, no duplicates. The remaining 32 of 753 leaves are structural heading nodes (قسم/subdivision titles) with no sequence and placeholder body text, not articles.
